A note from me to you

Read this when you can

Happy Birthday to the most unexpected blessing of my life 🫠💗 I think some people come into your life and quietly become family. You're one of them. Through the late-night talks, the silly jokes that only we understand (chindi), you've been there every time. You never made me feel like I had to be anything other than myself, and that's a rare kind of gift. I don't take it for granted. So, on your special day, I really hope life gives you back everything you've given to others: loyalty, laughter, and the kind of love that doesn't ask for anything in return. You truly deserve peace in your heart and success in your work. ⭐ Here's to celebrating you today and always. 🎉
With love and best wishes,
— Drishti
